svg.title: TOPAK G3 — Theorem to premise: what every checked property rests on, and what is void at the reference
svg.desc: spec/theorem-premise-binding.md (2026.09.30, revised 2026.10.01, DRAFT, revised with the records it binds) is the table ADR-0045 §3 owes and ADR-0023 §2 assumes: one row per checked property, naming the trusted-base rows (ADR-0045 Annex A), the degeneracy parameters (ADR-0023 §6a) and the declared gaps it rests on. A property holds for a deployment when every row it names is declared delegated or trust root, every parameter holds and no gap premise is false; otherwise it is void. Drawn three ways: the key chains as a DAG, the full incidence matrix, and the table itself, all 42 rows.

svg.text: spec/theorem-premise-binding.md (2026.09.30, revised 2026.10.01, DRAFT, revised with the records it binds) is the table ADR-0045 §3 owes and ADR-0023 §2 assumes: one row per checked property, naming the trusted-base rows (ADR-0045 Annex A), the degeneracy parameters (ADR-0023 §6a) and the declared gaps it rests on. A property holds for a deployment when every row it names is declared delegated or trust root, every parameter holds and no gap premise is false;
otherwise it is void. Drawn three ways: the key chains as a DAG, the full incidence matrix, and the table itself, all 42 rows.
One row per checked property: what it assumed. A property is void for a deployment when a row it names is excluded,
undeclared (ADR-0045 §3 rule 1) or refused, or a parameter or gap premise is false.
The last column computes ADR-0023 §2's inventory for the reference against ADR-0045 Annex B.
A proof of anything. Every property was checked by TLC at small constants, or restated as a test, by the same hands that
A row says what a check assumed; it does not strengthen the check.
T-0045-1 replicas apply the ordered log as crash-fault machines; T-0045-11 the records are the ratified records; T-0045-29
TLC at the constants run; T-0045-30 the build toolchain.

text.tspan: Status of the table and its record

svg.text: ADR-0045 is Accepted (genesis), confirmation required C2, C4 (Batch 22, R6 added the table).
The table itself is a DRAFT, revised with the records it binds; its versioning belongs to the archetype-evolution record, still
unwritten (G7 item 7). Never… witnesses are not theorems and are omitted.

text.tspan: 1 · Three chains, drawn as a DAG: each property points at the premises it rests on (BASE omitted)

svg.text: Left: premise nodes, coloured by their class at the reference (ADR-0045 Annex B). Right: checked properties, coloured by the table's last column. An edge runs from a property to a premise it names; a dashed edge is a premise that applies only at one declared rung. Edges take the colour of the property, so a red edge ends at what makes its property void.

text.tspan: 2 · The full incidence matrix: 42 rows × 30 trusted-base rows, 17 parameters, 5 gaps and inputs

svg.text: Rows in the table's order, grouped by module. A column's chip and every dot in it carry the premise's class at the reference, so a void row shows the red dot that voids it. A large dot is a premise the row names; a ring is one it names only at a declared rung; a small grey dot is a BASE premise; a square is a parameter, gap or input premise. Uncited rows (T-0045-7, T-0045-26) are drawn so their absence shows.

text.tspan: Reading the last column as an inventory (the file's own words)

svg.text: At the reference, every theorem premised on confinement, gate evidence, hermeticity or channel fidelity is void; the routing theorem and the gate verdicts rest on checked proofs since 2026.10.01, where before they were the solver's assertion; the bundle's
revision is a file name; the reach bound is declared and not enforced.

What remains holds of the modules and, by trace validation, of the running code on every tested path: the lease, the fence, revocation, composition, the rules floor, the bootstrap pair, seats, any-of, coupling with its collusion gap, Run's counters and seal. That is
ADR-0045 Annex B's inventory sentence, computed.

text.tspan: Keeping it current, and where it is stale

svg.text: A new property adds a row; a new T-row or degeneracy adds a premise; an ADR-0033 addendum that changes a row's class at the reference changes the last column. tools/check-refs.py does not read this file.
A premise edge added into an existing theorem weakens it and needs its own record (ADR-0023 carried scope); the archetype-evolution record owns that rule (G6 item 7).

Stale as drawn: the inventory sentence still says "the bundle's revision is a file name" while its own BundleRefusalHonored row says the revision is verified since 2026.10.01; the trace row says 21 traces, where G7 §3 records 22 traces, 168 steps at
